# Figure

An image with a caption and a credit, cropped to a ratio.

```tsx
import { Figure } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- For photographs and illustrations that belong to the text.

## When not to

- For decorative images in the layout: use a CSS background, or `alt=""`.
- For a screenshot of text: put the text in the page.

## Examples

### Image with caption and credit

The alt text says what the image shows; the caption says why it is here.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-xl">
  <Figure src="/portada.svg" alt="Una luna dorada sobre dos colinas oscuras" caption="La luz llega siempre tarde al fondo del cuadro." credit="Ilustración de ejemplo" />
</div>
```

### Ratios

Crop to a ratio so a page does not jump while images load.

```tsx
<div className="grid max-w-xl grid-cols-2 gap-4">
  <Figure src="/portada.svg" alt="Una luna dorada sobre dos colinas oscuras" ratio="1/1" />
  <Figure src="/portada.svg" alt="Una luna dorada sobre dos colinas oscuras" ratio="3/4" />
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` (required) | `string` |  |  |
| `alt` (required) | `string` |  | Describes the image for people who cannot see it. Required. Pass `""` only when the image is purely decorative. |
| `caption` | `ReactNode` |  | Caption below the image: what it shows and why it is here. |
| `credit` | `ReactNode` |  | Photographer or source, shown after the caption. |
| `ratio` | `FigureRatio` | `'16/10'` | Crops the image to a ratio. `auto` keeps the image's own. |
| …rest | `ImgHTMLAttributes<HTMLImageElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Alt text is required.** Say what the image shows; pass `""` only if it is purely decorative.
- **Layout stability:** pass `width` and `height` or a ratio so the page does not jump while the image loads.
- **Loading:** lazy and async by default.
- The caption and the credit are text, 4.5:1 or better.

## Content

- The caption says why the image is there; the alt text says what is in it.
- Credit the photographer or source.
